backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with access control, blob storage mixins, and many core types for users, rituals, pairing, love languages, stats, and challenges.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries mapping feature requests to affected frontend files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains a JSON-style mapping of frontend file paths to brief human-readable summaries describing each file's purpose and functionality.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based styles including OKLCH tokens, light/dark theme variables, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting favicon assets, theme-color, pre-React theme initialization script, and the root mount for the React app.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Provides a detailed manual QA checklist covering version checks, theming, authentication, pairing, rituals, and other app behaviors.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing authentication flow, profile setup, navigation, and conditional rendering of pages and loading states.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a bottom navigation bar allowing users to switch between app tabs with icons and active-state styling.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Displays a floating heart animation using randomly positioned hearts triggered on completion events.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable loading, empty, error, and section header UI components for data-driven views.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Shows current harmony score, trend summary, and a 7‑day sparkline with explanations and conditional data handling.
Compact harmony summary button displaying score and trend, linking users to detailed insights.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Dialog component that displays informational content for landing page footer links such as contact, terms, and privacy.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Animated rotating screenshot showcase inside a phone frame for the landing page hero section.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: A touch- and mouse-enabled screenshot carousel with navigation buttons and swipe handling.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and reactive UI.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Static card announcing upcoming love challenges with themed visuals.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Interactive card showing love language status with primary and secondary actions and optional highlight.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Profile setup form that collects a user name, initializes the profile, and shows success or error states.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Placeholder reward and progress visualization with heart-shaped progress and milestone indicators.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Daily spin wheel selecting a random love language with easing animation and saved daily results.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Small toggle button switching between light and dark themes.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Defines unlockable love‑language activity packs and a component for selecting them based on quiz completion and streak progress.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Exports a multiline narrative string describing the origin story of the Grow In Love app.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Implements a theme context that manages light, dark, and system themes with persistence and DOM class updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, clear, and status management using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend calls in React Query hooks for profiles, admin checks, pairing, and other app data operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re‑exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, theme variables, Tailwind layers, and animations for the app’s visual design.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Renders the Activities page, gating content based on authentication, pairing, and admin status, and displaying challenges, rewards, and an interactive wheel.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Manages the daily ritual flow including prompts, submissions, history display, and media uploads with multiple dialogs and animations.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Displays relationship insights such as streaks, harmony trends, quiz alignment, and badge milestones with backend‑driven stats.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Implements the public landing page with hero section, features, navigation, dialogs, and call‑to‑action to enter the app.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Handles the full love languages quiz flow including questions, scoring, saving results, and showing user/partner quiz states.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays a list of ritual memory entries with expandable details, love language metadata, and photo-backed responses.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Manages user pairing, profile state, admin checks, and quiz results with UI for generating and completing pairing codes.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helper functions for converting harmony values to percentages, normalizing trend data, and generating trend labels and display info.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hashes, and session storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, typography, animations, and content paths for the frontend build.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, current tasks, image requirements, and known issues for the landing page redesign and deployment.
